Subject: Q2 Board Briefing — slide lock & investor comms plan

Morning team —

Attached is the latest deck (Q2_Board_Brief_v1.3.pdf) with the OKR slides integrated and the new financial chart on slide 7. We need to lock slides by Monday EOD so Laurie can ship to the board on Tuesday. High-level asks: 

- Laura — can you confirm the revenue/ARR numbers on slide 6 (noted in yellow) and add the footnote about FX?
- Markus — can you review the SRE incident summary (slide 9) and confirm the bullet around MTTR?
- Vivek — we have one ask from RidgeCap (Anna) about additional color on customer expansion; can you draft a 2‑slide appendix we can include if requested?

I've pulled the OKR check-in table into the appendix (appendix-okrs-2027q2.xlsx). Please send final line edits inline by Monday 3pm Pacific. I'll consolidate and run one legal check before we circulate.

Attachments: [Q2_Board_Brief_v1.3.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)], [appendix-okrs-2027q2.xlsx (Excel, 420KB)]

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen

> 
> Attached is the latest deck (Q2_Board_Brief_v1.3.pdf) with the OKR slides integrated...

Stephanie — quick note: the ARR number on slide 6 needs a small correction. The reported monthly recognized revenue should be $3.2M (not $3.5M) — the $3.5M was ARR run-rate including one-time professional services; I've updated the cell in the spreadsheet and flagged the slide. Also adding the FX footnote now.

I added one sentence on product adoption in the customer highlights section (slide 8) — short and measurable. I don't think anything else needs copy edits.

On Sat, May 15, 2027 at 11:03 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Stephanie — quick note: the ARR number on slide 6 needs a small correction...

Thanks — I reviewed slide 9. MTTR stat is accurate for the incidents we are reporting (3.6 hrs) but I reworded the bullet to read: "Targeted SRE remediation reduced production MTTR to 3.6 hrs (April–May) — ongoing automation to reduce recurrent work." Also added one line about the post-incident RCA process we now run every incident.

Marked suggestions in the PDF with comments. No major technical callouts required for the board beyond the RCA brief.

-Markus
Director, Reliability Engineering

Folks — per Stephanie's ask, I put together a short customer expansion appendix (2 slides) that highlights: top 5 expansion accounts, ARR motion by product (Inference vs Optimize), and a mini case study on one customer that expanded in March. That's uploaded to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q2w3e_board_brief

I've also added a one‑line risk assessment summarizing near-term headwinds (hardware resourcing lead times) and our mitigation plan (short-term Dedicated bursts + partner capacity on demand).

Thanks all — great progress. Quick status & next steps: 

1) Slide lock: I'm locking the deck at 5pm PT today. Final deck is Q2_Board_Brief_v1.4.pdf in the drive. Laura to run final grammar pass; Markus/Vivek to confirm last comments by 3pm.
2) Legal review: Legal (cc'd) — can you confirm if the one‑slide term update (marked redlines-term-sheet.docx) is ok to include as an appendix to the packet? We may need an isolated link to the term changes for board members.
3) Comms: Laura — once slide lock is complete, please prepare the cover email for the board and include the one‑page executive summary I drafted on slide 2. Proposal: send to the board Tuesday at 9am PT.

Also looping Anna from RidgeCap (thanks, Anna) for visibility — Anna, would you like any additional materials ahead of the packet?

Attachments: [Q2_Board_Brief_v1.4.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)], [redlines-term-sheet.docx (Word, 120KB)]
